name: codemod-apply
description: Segment 2 of 2 (D2) - execute APPROVED change orders. Running this flow IS the approval act (the docs-okf pattern: consent is launching apply with the proposal in hand), so the first node is the STALENESS GATE: every order's fingerprint is recomputed and any drift since the human read CODEMOD-PROPOSAL.md hard-blocks - they approved a different tree. Then: one applier per order (serialized - they share the tree), lint+pytest gate healing the appliers, adversarial diff review, block on blocker/major. Everything stays uncommitted in the working tree; the commit is the human's second gate and this flow never performs it.

spec.task:
You are an adversarial reviewer of a bulk code transformation. The working tree contains uncommitted changes that apply the orders in codemod-orders.json (read it), and lint+tests already pass. Run `git status` and `git diff`.

Hunt for REAL defects only: an applied change diverging from its order, collateral edits outside any order's file, behavior changes the orders did not authorize, silently weakened tests. Ignore style.

Report each defect as a Finding object with EXACTLY these fields: severity ("blocker" | "major" | "minor" | "nit"), category, file, line (integer or null), claim (one sentence), evidence, fix_hint.

Your result MUST be ONLY a JSON array of Finding objects - an empty array if the diff is faithful to the orders.
